  - (1, 2): Red
  - (2, 2): Red
  - (3, 2): Red
  - (3, 3): Green

The only reason to negotiate a contract is if I can end with *more* chips, thus increasing my score. That happens only if you spend your chips to cover tiles on my path, allowing me to retain mine.   - (3, 3): Green
